# Locations & Battles

## Academy {#academy}

The Academy, also known as Queen's, is an educational institution located in town near [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) where students from various places, including [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), pursue First Class or Second Class teacher's licenses and compete for honors such as medals and the Avery scholarship.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue, named by the locals of [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) and dubbed the "White Way of Delight" by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), is a four- to five-hundred-yard stretch of road completely arched over by wide-spreading apple trees planted by an eccentric old farmer.

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is a rural community where [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), home to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Lovers' Lane are located.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) Pye's challenge to walk the ridgepole of the kitchen roof, but she loses her balance and falls. She breaks her ankle in the fall, which causes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and looks forward to returning to school to meet the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

## Beechwood {#beechwood}

Beechwood is the residence of [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), located in town, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays while taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams.

**Associated with:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a narrow, scenic woodland trail fringed with white birches and wild flora that runs through Mr. Bell's woods to the main road, serving as part of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's picturesque route to school.

> Following the excitement of the concert, school routines resume alongside minor classroom feuds. Walking to school on her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her story writing and imagination with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later establishes a story club with her friends and shares her enthusiasm and stories with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a town in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born in a small yellow house, and where her parents, Walter and Bertha [Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), worked as high school teachers before both dying of fever.

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a city where a cousin of [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) Pye's mother resides and is married to a man who attended school with a distinguished, romantic-looking artist.

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location eight miles from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a train station house with a long platform and a small hotel with a yard.

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, but learns from the stationmaster that a young girl was dropped off instead. He meets the talkative young orphan and decides to bring her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to handle the mistake, enjoying her lively chatter along the drive.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

## Camelot {#camelot}

Camelot is a romantic, historical setting featured in Tennyson's poetry, which [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) envies for its old-fashioned romance and incorporates into a dramatic game with her friends.

## Canada {#canada}

Canada is a nation governed from Ottawa whose political affairs are a frequent topic of debate among electors like Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## Canadian {#canadian}

Canadian refers to a native-born individual from [Canada](../codex/places.md#canada), whom [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) preferred to adopt over a child from [England](../codex/places.md#england) or the United [States](../codex/places.md#states).

## Carmody {#carmody}

Carmody is a nearby location that hosts meetings for the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society).

## Charlottetown {#charlottetown}

Charlottetown is a location on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) where travelers can board a train and observe the area's distinctive red roads.

**Associated with:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)

## Dryad’s Bubble {#dryad-s-bubble}

The Dryad's Bubble is a spring located in a hollow near a log bridge and a spruce path that leads to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) after a spring in a story.

## Edward Island {#edward-island}

Edward Island, also referred to as Prince Edward Island, is a region where custom dictates that travelers nod to everyone they meet on the road.

## England {#england}

England is a distant location mentioned by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as a place far enough from the Island that adopting a child from there might yield someone quite different from local residents.

## Entrance {#entrance}

The Entrance is an examination taken by advanced students to qualify for admission into Queen's.

## Exhibition {#exhibition}

The Exhibition is an event held in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to which [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) invited [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit and stay with her at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood).

**Participants:** [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family homestead in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a big, rambling house situated at the far edge of their cleared land at the end of a long, grassy lane.

**Associated with:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)

> Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly driving away from Green Gables dressed in his best clothes. Intrigued, she walks over to visit [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to find out where he went. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to the station to collect an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) whom they are adopting, leaving Mrs. [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) thoroughly shocked and skeptical about the decision.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at Green Gables and admires the beautiful morning view from her window before being called to breakfast by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). During breakfast and while doing chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks exuberantly, which makes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) nervous and highlights Matthew's quiet desire to keep the girl. Refusing to go outside to avoid falling further in love with the place, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) names Marilla's houseplant Bonny before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to take her to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs to bed, scolding her for being untidy and discovering that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never been taught how to say her prayers. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites a uniquely improvised prayer at Marilla's prompting, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to the kitchen shocked by Anne's spiritual ignorance and resolves to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she will educate the girl properly.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

> Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits Green Gables and makes blunt, critical remarks about Anne's red hair and appearance. In a fit of fury, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explodes at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), insulting her back before fleeing to her bedroom. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gently reprimands [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room, ordering her to stay there until she agrees to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently convinces her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her room. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) agrees, informs [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and they walk over to Mrs. Lynde's house, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a dramatically thorough apology. Touched by Anne's performance, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) forgives her and gives her hope about her hair color, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) both relieved and amused as she walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to Green Gables.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

## Haunted Wood {#haunted-wood}

The Haunted Wood is a gloomy spruce grove located over the brook that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imaginatively populated with romantic ghosts, including a wailing white lady, a murdered child's ghost near [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), a headless man, and skeletons.

## Hopeton {#hopeton}

Hopeton is a place where Mrs. Alexander Spencer's cousin lives and the location of an orphan asylum.

## Idlewild {#idlewild}

Idlewild is the poetical name invented by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the playhouse she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set up in a ring of white birch trees on Mr. William Bell's land.

## Lover {#lover}

Lover's Lane is a romantic pathway opening below the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard, extending into the woods to the end of the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) use as part of their scenic walk to school.

## Lynde’s Hollow {#lynde-s-hollow}

Lynde’s Hollow is a depression where the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) main road dips down, featuring a home, an orchard, a quiet brook fringed with alders and ladies’ eardrops, and a view of the steep red hill road leading out of the peninsula.

## Marysville {#marysville}

Marysville is a place where Mr. and Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) moved after leaving [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) lived and briefly attended school until she was eight years old.

## Merry Christmas {#merry-christmas}

On a snowy morning in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a fashionable brown dress with puffed sleeves from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), a matching hair ribbon from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and dainty kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) before starring in a successful evening concert at the local hall.

## New Brunswick {#new-brunswick}

New Brunswick is a region where [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visited his cousins over the summer and the location of a tragic incident in which an adopted girl poisoned her family's well.

## Newbridge {#newbridge}

Newbridge is a bustling little village featuring a tree-canopied stretch of road called the "[Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue)" that leads down a long slope into the town.

## Nova Scotia {#nova-scotia}

Nova Scotia is a [Canadian](../codex/places.md#canadian) region home to an orphan asylum, situated close to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island).

## Orchard Slope {#orchard-slope}

Orchard Slope is the home of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her family, featuring a house with a western gable located up through a brook and the firs from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

**Associated with:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)

> After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Orchard Slope to confess to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her in the spare-room bed. Anne's candid apology and imaginative conversation charm the old lady, prompting her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and become close friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

## Redmond College {#redmond-college}

Redmond College is an institution of higher learning that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was eligible to attend using her scholarship before deciding to forego her studies there to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## Shining Waters {#shining-waters}

The Lake of Shining Waters is a long, winding body of water—locally known as Barry's pond—spanned by a bridge and surrounded by sand-hills, marshland, and groves of fir and maple.

## Snow Queen {#snow-queen}

The Snow Queen is the name given by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the exceptionally white, blooming cherry tree located outside her bedroom window.

## Spencervale {#spencervale}

Spencervale is a nearby locale whose resident physician attended to [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during her bout with croup and later advised [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's health.

**Associated with:** [Chester Ross](../character/chester-ross.md)

## States {#states}

The States is a foreign region where [French](../codex/factions.md#french) farm workers frequently relocate after learning local agricultural practices, located at a greater distance from Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) than [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Violet Vale is a green dimple in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's woods, named by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), that sits along the scenic route she and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) take to school and is said to be filled with millions of violets in the spring.

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

The White Sands Hotel is a large establishment run by Mr. Kirke along the shore, popular with American tourists visiting for the summer season.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets dressed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with Diana's help before traveling to the White Sands Hotel for a charity concert. Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels intimidated by the city performers and suffers a brief moment of severe stage fright. Spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience restores her determination, leading to a successful performance, an encore, and praise from the other attendees.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

## Willowmere {#willowmere}

Willowmere is a scenic location situated past Mr. Barry's back field along the romantic route that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school.
